full_prompt_en: A square, brightly lit photographic portrait centers a man from the chest upward against closely spaced vertical bands of saturated color. He has tousled dark brown hair beneath a pale rounded cap. Large circular spectacles sit over wide blue eyes; the left rim is vivid cyan and the right is bright yellow. His brows rise and his mouth remains open in surprise as he looks above the camera. Dark stubble softens the jaw and upper lip. A white shirt and bold red tie show beneath a pale suit jacket covered in broad pastel stripes of pink, lavender, turquoise, cream and orange. The shoulders nearly reach both sides of the frame. Behind the head, vivid vertical strips of orange, magenta, blue, yellow and lime run from top to bottom, creating a simple graphic backdrop. Warm red-orange light washes the lower face and right side of the jacket, while cooler cyan fills the opposite side and gives the skin a playful two-tone cast. The face remains sharply focused, with visible hair strands, fabric weave and small skin textures. The backdrop has crisp color divisions but almost no depth, making the man appear close to a painted wall. Circular glasses contrast with the straight background stripes and the downward angles of the lapels. The composition is frontal and tightly cropped, with the startled expression as its clear center. The whole image uses high color saturation, symmetrical framing and theatrical light to turn a simple pose into an energetic, pop-like visual.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、明亮照明的摄影肖像把男子胸部以上置于紧密并排的饱和竖向色带前。他深棕头发略乱，戴一顶浅色圆帽。宽大的圆眼镜罩住睁大的蓝眼睛；左边镜框是鲜青色，右边是亮黄色。他眉毛抬起，嘴巴因惊讶张开，目光越过镜头向上。深色胡茬柔化下颌和上唇。白衬衫与醒目的红领带露在浅色西装外套内，外套覆盖粉、淡紫、青绿、奶油和橙色宽条。肩膀几乎触到画面两侧。头后鲜橙、洋红、蓝、黄和青柠绿竖带从上到下贯穿，形成简单的图形背景。暖红橙光洗过脸下部和外套右边，较冷青光填入另一侧，让肤色有俏皮的双色调。面孔保持锐利对焦，发丝、布纹和小皮肤肌理可见。背景色带分界清楚，却几乎没有纵深，使男子看起来紧贴一面彩绘墙。圆镜框对照直线背景条带与向下倾斜的翻领。构图正面且裁切紧，惊讶表情成为明确中心。整幅图用高饱和色、对称取景和舞台光，把简单姿势变成充满能量的波普视觉。
style_prompt_en: The image has a crisp photographic surface with sharply resolved central detail and a flat, high-saturation graphic background. Broad vertical bands of orange, magenta, yellow, cyan and lime divide the frame into strong color areas. Warm red light and cool blue fill meet across near forms, creating a theatrical split-tone effect while preserving visible texture. Rounded accent shapes interrupt the straight striping, and diagonal edges near the lower frame add a third rhythm. The composition is frontal, close and nearly symmetrical, with little environmental depth. Hard color boundaries remain clean behind softer modeled surfaces. Brightness is even enough to keep details readable, but colored side light gives the central mass dimensional contrast. Smooth areas and small material textures coexist without losing the simple graphic impact. The overall mood is playful and immediate, driven by precise focus, bold stripes and controlled complementary color.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有清晰的摄影表面，中央细节锐利，背景是扁平高饱和图形。橙、洋红、黄、青和青柠绿宽竖带把画幅切成强色块。暖红光与冷蓝补光在近处形体上相遇，形成舞台般的分色效果，同时保留可见肌理。圆形强调打断直线条纹，下方斜边又加入第三种节奏。构图正面、贴近且近乎对称，环境纵深很小。背景硬色界面干净，前方塑形表面则较柔。亮度足以使细节清楚，彩色侧光仍给中央团块体积对照。平滑区域与细小材质肌理共存，没有削弱简单图形冲击。整体情绪俏皮直接，由准确对焦、醒目条纹和受控互补色驱动。
theme_en: A surprised man in split-color round glasses and a striped suit stands before saturated vertical rainbow bands
theme_zh: 一名戴双色圆眼镜、穿条纹西装的惊讶男子站在饱和竖向彩虹条带前
name: Ok go
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
